author: crazykrazy
quote: Grand Theft Auto VI is a perfect game. It has what everyone wants, the best graphics of all time, hell yeah, definitely worth 100 dollars for the "complete" standard edition, it has so much content that we had to sacrifice all physical discs but that doesnt matter, as long as i can watch my paywalled trailers, that's all it matters, anyways i may buy the deluxe 400 dollars edition in the future, all i hope is that there's another copy of my game there so that i can play two GTA's at the same time
